videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript in Korean, approximately 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences covering the key points.
Key points from the transcript:
1. Pete Hegseth (US Defense Secretary) attended Asian Security Conference (Shangri-La Dialogue) and emphasized alliance burden-sharing, warning against "free-riding" on security. He mentioned countries like Korea, Japan, Australia as examples of increasing defense spending.
2. He emphasized combat power over empty talk and maintaining military presence in Indo-Pacific regarding China, though less harsh criticism than last year (considering recent US-China summit).
3. South Korean Defense Minister An Kyu-bae is attending the conference for the first time in 2 years, holding bilateral talks with Japan, Philippines, Norway, Netherlands.
4. Korea-Japan defense minister talks will discuss resuming joint search and rescue exercises between Korean Navy and Japanese Maritime Self-Defense Force.
5. Possible trilateral meeting (Korea-US-Japan) defense ministers.
6. An Kyu-bae will meet US congressional delegations to request support for defense policies including nuclear-powered submarine acquisition, and give a keynote speech on response to threats.

1. Shangri-La Dialogue opened in Singapore with Asia-Pacific security leaders
2. US Defense Secretary Hegseth attended and emphasized US and allied security
3. Hegseth stated no country including China should exercise hegemony in Asia
4. He called South Korea taking the lead in wartime operational control "encouraging"
5. He urged allies to increase defense spending to 3.5% of GDP, praised South Korea for promising this
6. He mentioned Taiwan defense is necessary but arms sales depend on Trump
7. China Defense Minister Dong Jun is absent, so no US-China defense minister talks
